standard_prerequisites.name: Presentation improvement with retraction
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces A -> C with retraction, C smooth over A, and freeness of J/J^2 at lci points.

standard_prerequisites.name: Huber's presentation lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Chooses generators f_1, ..., f_c of the presentation ideal mapping to a basis of J/J^2.

standard_prerequisites.name: Fibre dimension of a local complete intersection
standard_prerequisites.use: Fibres of C over R are lci, so they have dimension n - c.

core_obligations: Apply the improve-presentation lemma to get a smooth R-algebra map A -> C with a retraction.
By Huber's lemma write C = R[x_1, ..., x_n]/(f_1, ..., f_c) with the f_i mapping to a basis of J/J^2.
R -> C is syntomic, hence flat, as the composition of the syntomic R -> A with the smooth A -> C.
Each fibre is a local complete intersection, so the fibre dimension is n - c by the lci dimension lemma.
proof_roadmap: Presentation improvement; Huber generators; syntomic composition; fibre dimension count.
